structured_output.summary: Add the new datastructure helpers first, then the two new Response methods, migrate send_file and SharedDataMiddleware onto them, and only then deprecate make_conditional and the http helpers (warnings are errors in the test config). Docs and changelog come last.

intents.rationale: apply_range does not exist; range logic lives in private _process_range_request.
make_conditional is not deprecated and uses the old helpers.
Range.make_content_range delegates to is_byte_range_valid and does not clamp; must validate itself so http helper can be deprecated.
ETagSet.from_header must drop invalid unquoted values.

evidence.quote: def from_header(cls, value: str | None) -> te.Self:

intents.rationale: send_file still uses make_conditional and path-hash etag.
Middleware uses its own loader and is_resource_modified.
Tests need to be added/updated across files.

criteria.text: IfRange.check(etag, last_modified) is true for a strong equal etag or an equal date, false otherwise (including empty IfRange and weak/other etags).

Range.make_content_range clamps too-large stop/suffix to the length, uses the first range only, returns None when unsatisfiable, and does not call werkzeug.http.is_byte_range_valid; Range.from_header and ContentRange.from_header validate values.
apply_conditions evaluates If-Match, If-Unmodified-Since, If-None-Match, If-Modified-Since in RFC 9110 order for all methods; failed preconditions raise PreconditionFailed (412).
apply_conditions on GET/HEAD with satisfied If-None-Match/If-Modified-Since yields 304 with entity headers removed; on other methods If-None-Match failure raises 412; Accept-Ranges: bytes is set.
A star ETag in If-Match/If-None-Match is evaluated by the exists argument (exists=True vs False give different outcomes).

apply_range with a satisfiable bytes Range gives 206, sliced data, correct Content-Range and Content-Length; only the first range is used; too-large stop/suffix is clamped; If-Range mismatch skips the range.
apply_range raises RequestedRangeNotSatisfiable for an unsatisfiable range and ignores non-bytes units.

send_file detects name/size/mtime from file-likes, seeks to 0 (re-sending an already-read file works, range responses have correct lengths), ETag has no path hash, and mimetype defaults to application/octet-stream without download_name instead of raising; conditional and range requests are handled via apply_conditions/apply_range.

SharedDataMiddleware serves files through send_file, sets no cache_timeout by default (conditional requests yield 304), and passing cache or fallback_mimetype emits DeprecationWarning while still working.
Response.make_conditional emits DeprecationWarning and still behaves as before for GET/HEAD conditional and range cases via apply_conditions/apply_range.
http.is_resource_modified and http.is_byte_range_valid emit DeprecationWarning and still return the same results.
docs/quickstart.rst documents apply_conditions and apply_range; CHANGES.rst has an entry for the change.
Full suite passes with pytest -m "not dev_server".

tasks.summary: Add IfRange.check, make Range/ContentRange validate themselves without http.is_byte_range_valid (clamping, first range), and make ETagSet.from_header drop invalid unquoted values.
Add Response.apply_conditions and Response.apply_range (leave make_conditional untouched for now), with tests.
Refactor send_file onto apply_conditions/apply_range with file-like detection, seek(0), no path hash in ETag, octet-stream default; update send_file tests.
Serve SharedDataMiddleware files through send_file, drop default cache_timeout, deprecate cache and fallback_mimetype params; update its tests.

With all internal callers migrated, reimplement make_conditional through the new methods and deprecate it, and deprecate http.is_resource_modified/is_byte_range_valid; wrap existing tests in deprecated_call or move to new-method tests.
Document apply_conditions/apply_range in the quickstart and add a changelog entry.
